text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired for service=runtime-serving (p99 latency SLO burn). Alert: p95=720ms, p99=1350ms, SLO burn window 5m. Link: https://pd.example.com/incidents/INC-9876 :rotating_light:
PagerDuty: Incident INC-9876 triggered, urgency=high, assigned to team=oncall.
Alex (oncall): acked. I'm on it. Anyone seeing recent deploys?
Sara: no deploys from infra in last 2h. I'm pulling tail logs now.
Matt: seeing a spike of KV cache evictions ~3m ago, plus backend queue depth increase. Could be hotkey or eviction cascade.
Jin: GPUs report steady usage. CPU on sidecars up ~60%. Autoscaler shows scale events but new nodes not accepted fast enough (quota throttling?).
Alex (oncall): ok follow runbook step 1: check kvcache tail keys and sidecar logs. If hotkey, try immediate routing to fallback model. Runbook: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/latency-tail
Sara: grabbing kvcache metrics... top keys: user:session:host-192.168.1.42 -> 24k req/min, miss rate 78%. Hotkey confirmed.
Matt: logs show repeated 429 from sidecar at 17:12:03. snippet:
```
sidecar-1 17:12:03 WARN evict key user:session:host-192.168.1.42 reason=hotkey
sidecar-2 17:12:04 ERROR serve request id=abcd status=429 queue_depth=96
```
Jin: I can flip routing policy to route requests for that keyspace to the fallback pool (lower-cost model variant) for 10m to drain. That should reduce p99 tail. Want me to proceed?
Alex (oncall): do it. Set temporary rate-limit and route. Post commands you run. :thumbsup:
Jin: executed: `rbctl routes apply --matcher "keyspace=user:session" --target fallback-pool --duration 10m` -> routed. Also applied rate-limit: `rbctl rate-limit apply --matcher "keyspace=user:session" --rps 200`
PagerDuty: Incident INC-9876 acknowledged by Alex (oncall). Escalation suppressed.
Sara: after routing, p95 dropped to 360ms, p99 to 610ms in 45s. Miss rate on kvcache fell to 22%. Looks like routing helped.
Matt: autoscaler still queued capacity; I'll open a quota ticket but we shouldn't need immediate nodes for now.
Alex (oncall): good. Keep monitoring. Jin keep the route for 10m and we'll decide next steps.
Jin: routing will auto-revert in 10m. I'll extend if needed.
Sara: capturing logs for postmortem and saving a diff of the kvcache config.
Matt: recommend follow-ups: (1) add hotkey detector alert earlier, (2) increase fallback pool warm capacity, (3) investigate quota slow acceptance.
Alex (oncall): agreed. I'll create a follow-up ticket and assign owners. For now marking incident as mitigated but keep incident thread open for 30m. Thanks team. :tada:
